purpose: Discovery and readiness assessment of existing Pi telemetry extensions; no production enablement

limitations: All npm search queries are ranked results; only a partial keyword catalog was traversed. Initial search rate limiting is recorded; stopped rather than retrying indefinitely.
No repository dependency install, plugin integration, collector or service started. Three emitter probes use exact published modules but fake OTel handles.
Package publication dates are not package source maintenance dates. Downloads are not users.
Platform-branded integrations were not automatically excluded by names; unverified generic OTLP support remains explicit.

pi_catalog.search_method: Observed GET form action=/packages name=<term>, followed server-rendered Next pagination links; no inferred private API
limitations: Only name/description/author search surface and listed keywords searched, not all 5423 package sources
Package labels from catalog are not sufficient identity evidence; pi manifest read for focused packages
Catalog display download period may differ from npm API; not used for final relative ranking
Five packages source reviewed by this subtask: Grafana, ObservMe, Laminar, ramarivera, Latitude; other rows metadata leads
No installs, extension execution, compiler runs, collectors, or mobile performance measurements
Includes libraries, local-only tools and a SPEC-only repository
No search completeness claim; unindexed/private repos and branches not covered
